name: Council of AI — get_card
description: GET one public-root card-v0 leaf by sha256 (64 hex) from https://councilof.ai/cards/{sha16}.json. UNMEASURED cells stay visible. Three states: VALID (fetched), INVALID (not a leaf of the live root), UNCHECKABLE (fetch failed). Not a GSPC measurement-card.
